summary: Phase 3E live Control Tower Map end-to-end testing. Backend: 20/20 pytest passing on /api/wholesaler/{wid}/control-tower/map covering shape, 6 distributors derived from wholesaler_orders (not parent_org), MUTKEEM healthy + 5 critical, in-transit truck interpolation strictly between endpoints, delivered trucks pinned to destination, tenant scoping (403 for distributor/manufacturer/other-wholesaler), graceful empty-arrays response for tenant2 wholesaler. Frontend: Control Tower tab on /analytics renders ct-map > ct-live-map > logistics-map-card > logistics-map (Google Maps canvas), with map-demand-toggle working. Footer matches spec exactly: '7 warehouses · 1 active lanes · 1 trucks moving'. Static ct-network + ct-network-graph still render below the live map. Regressions clean: Intelligence Center (briefing/opportunities/risks/actions via ic-* testids), tab-inv and tab-forecast still functional.

issues: Review spec referenced testids 'intel-briefing/intel-opportunities/intel-risks/intel-actions' but actual testids are 'ic-briefing/ic-opportunities/ic-risks/ic-actions'. Functionality intact — naming-only discrepancy.

critical_code_review_comments: control_tower_map endpoint cleanly separates concerns: distributors derived via wholesaler_orders.distinct() + organizations.find() (no parent_org coupling), 90d revenue aggregation drives bubble sizing + health colouring, truck interpolation uses elapsed/(elapsed+eta_minutes) clamped to 0.0-0.95 (good safety bounds), demand overlay regions resolved via region OR state->region OR city fallback chain.
ng_geocode.py is in-memory only (no external API calls) — fast, deterministic, and consistent with 'no AI / pure DB' design constraint.
wholesaler_analytics.py grown to 2141 lines (was 1938) — splitting recommended on a future refactor sprint.
